title: Fourier coefficient of a piecewise function
statement: Let $Ω$ be a finite nonempty set with probability measure $π$, and let $ι$ be a finite nonempty index set. Suppose $B$ is a basis of real-valued functions on $Ω$ that is orthonormal for the $π$-weighted inner product and has a distinguished index $0_B$ whose basis function is constantly one. For every $n\ge 0$, proposition $P$, functions $f,g:Ω^n\to\mathbb R$, and multi-index $a\inι^n$, the Fourier coefficient at $a$ of the function equal to $f$ when $P$ holds and to $g$ otherwise equals the corresponding piecewise choice between the Fourier coefficients of $f$ and $g$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite nonempty basis index set $ι$ with decidable equality
Orthonormal basis of functions $Ω\to\mathbb R$ under $π$, with a distinguished constant-one basis vector
